list.text: Narrator: \bAnd today the Pokemon World Cup begins!!!
\bThis remarkable event that happens every 4 years, where the best Trainers in the world compete for the biggest prize!
\bToday we will have the opening ceremony, the group draw and the first battles, in what promises to be the best Pokemon World Cup of all time!
\bI now invite Red to light the flame of the tournament with the fire of Entei!!
He will take the torch from Prof. Oak hands, a former champion of the Pokemon World Cup and renowned Pokemon researcher!
